text:
Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x was the winner of y.
Participated(x, y) ::: x participated in y.
Tie(x, y) ::: x was part of a tie of size y.
FromBelgium(x) ::: x is from Belgium.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x was on the leaderboard of y.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
---
Premises:
Winner(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Participated(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (Tie(x, 6) ∧ ∃y (FromBelgium(y) ∧ MemberOfTie(y, x))) ::: There was a six-way tie and one person in that tie was from Belgium.
Descampe ∈ FromBelgium ::: Descampe is from Belgium.
OnLeaderboard(Descampe, duMaurier1992) ::: Descampe was on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992) → Participated(x, duMaurier1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard participated in the event.
---
Conclusion:
¬Winner(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was not the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
